nodes.label: Trade Plugin - Route Tab UI
nodes.rationale: Screenshot of the Trade plugin's 'Route' configuration tab, one of three tabs (Route, Settings, Job overview) in the Trade plugin UI. Provides two mutually exclusive route-definition modes via radio buttons: 'Trace player' (a text field, presumably to trace/follow a named player's movement as the route) and 'Use route list' (a dropdown selecting a saved route, plus a red 'X' button to delete and a green '+' button to add/record a route list entry, and a blue '[Record]' link in the top-right to record a new route). Below the mode selectors is a data grid listing saved routes with columns Name, Start region, End region, and Num. Steps (empty in this screenshot). A checkbox 'Run townscript after route finished' lets the route trigger a town script on completion. An italic hint at the bottom notes 'Automatic teleportation and town scripts are not supported in trace mode', indicating the Trace player mode has reduced automation capabilities compared to the route-list mode. Design purpose: lets the user configure how the trading bot navigates between buy/sell locations, either by recording/selecting a predefined multi-step route or by following another player in real time.
